in_marathi.name: Bhanuprasad
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessing of Lord Bhanu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhanuprasad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhanuprasad is a combination of two words - Bhanu and Prasad. Bhanu is a name of the Sun God, while Prasad means blessing. Therefore, Bhanuprasad means 'the blessing of Lord Bhanu'. This name is often given to a child born on a Sunday, as the Sun is the ruling planet of this day.
